channel.title: The Journal — Mr & Mrs Digital
channel.description: Straight answers about AI product photos and videos for small brands, Shopify and TikTok Shop sellers.

item.title: AI photos or a traditional photoshoot? How to choose
item.description: AI product photography vs a traditional photoshoot: when each one makes sense for a small brand, what they cost in the UK, and how to mix the two.

item.title: Can I make my own AI product photos?
item.description: Yes, you can make your own AI product photos with free and cheap tools. Here is how to start, where DIY images go wrong, and when it is worth paying a studio.

item.title: How much does AI product photography cost for a small brand?
item.description: AI product photos cost from £35 an image, or £495 a month for 15 images and 3 videos. Here is how that compares with UK photographer, studio and model costs.
